title: Philadelphia
lead: A city of Lydia in the Roman province of Asia, on the road from the Maeander valley to Sardis and Smyrna. Its church, weak and pressured, received one of the seven letters of Revelation, with only praise (Revelation 3:7–13), and later a letter from Ignatius of Antioch, who had visited it.
links: Epistle of Ignatius to the Philadelphians
